name: Voynich Folio
desc: A botanical folio from an undeciphered herbal: an impossible plant -- root ball, curling stem, lobed leaves and a spiked seed-head -- drawn in brown ink and faded blue-green wash, swaying gently while lines of looping gallows-script write themselves in around it, wrapping to the margins. A soft light rakes the aged vellum; when the folio fills it turns and a new specimen in a new script begins. Aged herbal colour, monochrome sepia, a dark nocturne with luminous ink, or a cyan blueprint negative.

energy.doc: ink and wash contrast and raking-light glow

speed.doc: writing rate, plant sway speed and how often the folio turns

sway.doc: how much the plant rocks and its leaves nod

hue.doc: vellum tone for the default; other styles fix their own

style.doc: aesthetic: aged herbal colour / monochrome sepia / dark nocturne with luminous ink / cyan blueprint negative

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-throws the plant, the script and the vellum toning
